Name: Beyond Bedtime
Author: KiraAylaria
Description:
[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. (Optional but highly recommended) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to easily edit settings in-game.
3. Download this mod and unzip it into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
4. Run the game using SMAPI![/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- [b]Customizable Pass-Out Time[/b]: Choose exactly when your farmer should pass out. Want to stay up until 4:00 AM to finish the Skull Cavern? Now you can!
- [b]Seamless HUD Clock[/b]: The in-game HUD clock continues to tick past 2:00 AM in 10-minute increments, just like vanilla time.
- [b]Lighting Transitions[/b]: The mod dynamically handles the transition of ambient and window lighting during extended nights, including optional settings for morning light curves.
- [b]Daily Toggle Hotkey[/b]: Pressed for time? Use a hotkey to completely disable passing out for the current day!
- [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) Support[/b]: Fully integrated with GMCM so you can change all settings in-game without editing config files.
- [b]Multiplayer Compatible[/b]: Features a decentralized architecture. Configurations are strictly local to each player. This means you can play with friends who have different pass-out times—or even friends who don't have the mod installed at all! The game will simply wait for everyone to go to sleep or pass out.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][size=3]SMAPI[/size][/url]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Optional)[/size][/color]
